summary: Keep native roster refreshes incremental for unrelated document/resource facts and serve a previous complete roster cut for up to five seconds during one shared background refresh. Attribute admission, queues, caches and card folds through the existing profiling facility.

replay.detail: Claim admission, canonical projection and checkpoints are unchanged. Replay clears the existing cache; no stored data migration.

rules.detail: No authority or checkpoint rule change.

compatibility.detail: Unfiltered current agents HTTP pages may return an explicit roster_cache refreshing marker, bounded monotonic age and original store/local cut. Stale continuations preserve their immutable rows and expire within the same five-second window. Owner/declaration/runtime/work changes, unknown inputs and expired queue leases require fresh reads. History and filtered requests keep their current behavior; cold initial reads still build. No IVM Source/Ready or collection activation change.

downtime.detail: No new daemon activation or mandatory restart mechanism. Deployment follows the ordinary binary rollout.

manual.detail: Existing ST3_PROFILE_DIR controls profiling. No new collector or profiling setting.

recovery.detail: Ordinary rollback to an earlier binary restores fresh-only HTTP roster reads. Background refresh failures leave the existing bounded-age entry and do not extend its lifetime.
